<!-- Generated by docs-infra Python API -->

```python
SafetensorsFile(path, *, mmap: bool = True)
```

Part of [`evoxc.formats`](/api/evoxc/formats/)

An open, validated safetensors file.

Use `load_safetensors` (or the constructor) to open it, then
`tensor_names`, `info`, `tensor` / `as_dict`.
The object owns a file handle/mapping: use it as a context manager or call
`close` when done.  Zero-copy views remain valid after `close`
only while the view itself is alive.

## as_dict

```python
as_dict() -> Dict[str, Tensor]
```

All tensors as `{name: Tensor}` (see `tensor`).

## close

```python
close() -> None
```

Release the file handle/mapping (idempotent, never raises).

## info

```python
info(name: str) -> TensorInfo
```

Descriptor (dtype/shape/stored byte size) for `name`.

## tensor

```python
tensor(name: str) -> Tensor
```

Materialize `name` as a host `~evoxc.core.Tensor`.

With `mmap=True` this is a zero-copy read-only view; with
`mmap=False` it is an independent writable copy.

## tensor_names

```python
tensor_names() -> List[str]
```

Tensor names in header order.
